mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (user_no, place_no, rating, content, hidden, create_at) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{placeNo}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{isHidden}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.review_no, r.place_no, r.user_no, u.nickname AS userNickname, r.rating, r.content, r.hidden, r.create_at AS createdAt FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_no = u.user_no WHERE r.place_no = #{placeNo} AND r.is_deleted = false ORDER BY r.create_at DESC

SELECT r.review_no, r.place_no, r.user_no, u.nickname AS userNickname, p.title AS placeTitle, r.rating, r.content, r.hidden, r.create_at AS createdAt FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_no = u.user_no JOIN place p ON r.place_no = p.place_no WHERE r.user_no = #{userNo} AND r.is_deleted = false ORDER BY r.create_at DESC
SELECT review_no, place_no, user_no, rating, content, hidden, create_at AS createdAt FROM review WHERE review_no = #{reviewNo} AND is_deleted = false
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET rating = #{rating}, content = #{content}, hidden = #{isHidden} WHERE review_no = #{reviewNo} AND is_deleted = false
UPDATE place p SET rating = ( SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) FROM review r WHERE r.place_no = #{placeNo} AND r.is_deleted = false ) WHERE p.place_no = #{placeNo}
mapper.select: SELECT place_no FROM review WHERE review_no = #{reviewNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_image (review_no, review_img_name, origin_name, create_at) VALUES (#{reviewNo}, #{reviewImgName}, #{originName}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT review_img_name FROM review_image WHERE review_no = #{reviewNo}
